ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RT-4,
Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit Districts the B3-3, Community Shopping
Districts and indications as shown on Map No. 7-I in the area bound by:

      North Linden Avenue; the alley next east of and parallel to North Kedzie Boulevard;
      North Albany Avenue; and North Kedzie Boulevard,

to those of a B3-1, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                         ____________________________
                                                         Carlos Ramirez-Rosa
                                                         Alderman, 35th Ward




Common Address:
2443-2511 North Kedzie Boulevard
